_comment: Route (a) with the check_tracking rules on: a Shopify export trimmed to Name, Fulfillment Status, Fulfilled at, Shipping Method, Shipping Country plus the added Delivery Status column. US store (ship_from_country US) shipping to US, CA and GB. Today 2026-12-08 (Tuesday). Promise = Fulfilled at + US 5 / CA 8 / GB 10 business days, weekends and 2026-11-26 closed. Merchant says orders normally arrive within US 5 / CA 8 / GB 10 calendar days, and Tracking added or No status for more than 3 days after Fulfilled at is suspicious. Hand-checked.

why.#3101: US, fulfilled 11-24, promised 12-02 (11-26 skipped); In transit, 6 days late. Late wins over any candidate rule
why.#3103: US (domestic) Delayed, promised 12-09: delivery_problem, and NOT a customs candidate because it is not international
why.#3104: CA Delayed, promised 12-11: delivery_problem wins over check_tracking; possible_customs_hold is a flag so the merchant checks tracking before choosing the Delivery problem or Held at customs message
why.#3105: US In transit, fulfilled 6 days ago > normal 5, promised 12-09 not late: possible stall
why.#3106: US In transit, fulfilled exactly 5 days ago = normal 5, not more: on track
why.#3107: US Tracking added 4 days after Fulfilled at > 3: possible_not_scanned (4 is not > 5, so no possible_stall)
why.#3108: US Tracking added exactly 3 days: on track
why.#3109: CA In transit, fulfilled 11-27 = 11 days > normal 8, promised 12-09 not late: possible stall and possible customs hold, one group
why.#3110: GB In transit, fulfilled 11-25 = 13 days > normal 10, promised 12-10: possible stall and possible customs hold
why.#3111: GB In transit 7 days <= 10: on track
why.#3112: GB In transit, fulfilled 11-16, promised 12-01, 7 days late: late, with possible_customs_hold flag
why.#3113: CA No status 5 days > 3: possible_not_scanned; No status is not a customs candidate
why.#3117: US Attempted delivery, promised 12-08 = today, not late: delivery_problem
why.#3119: GB Tracking added 6 days: possible_not_scanned only; Tracking added is not a customs candidate
why.#3120: US No status, promised 12-03, 5 days late: late, not check_tracking
